name: journal-lens
description: Journal Lens 是一个 Manifest V3 Chrome 插件，用于在常见学术出版网站上显示期刊指标，并提供不改写论文标题链接的检索按钮。

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node tests/background-easyscholar-smoke.js && node tests/easyscholar-smoke.js && node tests/local-showjcr-smoke.js
scripts.test:browser: node tests/ablesci-smoke.js && node tests/content-smoke.js && node tests/options-smoke.js && node tests/popup-smoke.js
scripts.check:syntax: node --check extension/src/background.js && node --check extension/src/build-flags.js && node --check extension/src/shared.js && node --check extension/src/showjcr.js && node --check extension/src/storage.js && node --check extension/content/ablesci.js && node --check extension/content/content.js && node --check extension/options/options.js && node --check extension/popup/popup.js
